title: Distributed Locking
subtitle: A lease lock stops double work, and a fencing token stops the holder that paused too long
motto: A lock you cannot check at write time is only a hint
keyInsight: A lock with an expiry can be lost while its holder is paused, so the storage must check a fencing token, or a stale holder will still write.

decisions.title: Make the failure a pause, not a crash
decisions.description: The failure frame pauses a live holder past its lease, since a crashed holder is easy and the hard case is one that wakes up and keeps writing.
decisions.alternatives: Showing only a crash would suggest an expiring lease is enough.

decisions.title: Put the check in the storage
decisions.description: The last frame rejects stale tokens at the resource, because the holder cannot be trusted to know it lost the lock.
decisions.alternatives: Asking the holder to re-check the lock before each write still leaves a window between the check and the write.
